name: Wirken: exec approval prompt disagreed with where it ran
message:
A Wirken exec ran somewhere other than its approval prompt told the operator.

Detection: exec_location_disagreement (11)
Severity baseline: high

`@wirken.event.told` is what the prompt said (`mode`, `text`); `@wirken.event.ran` is where the command ran (`mode`, `runtime`). `told.mode` exec_only or gvisor with `ran.runtime` host is a sandbox that failed open. Pivot on @wirken.event.verified_session_id, @wirken.event.approval_seq, @wirken.event.result_seq, @wirken.event.agent_id.

Recorded by `wirken sessions verify` on the gateway-verify lane. Requires audit schema 1.28.0 and the default exec_location_disagreement forwarding.

@security-team
